integrity: The proof is analytic. It uses the separately weighted defect estimate already present before the final coefficient collapse in the proof of Theorem C of arXiv:2610.03619v1, then applies elementary positive-cone comparison and the Kantorovich dual bound. No numerical experiment or external certification establishes the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The certified perturbation radius is not claimed optimal; both weights must be positive; and the result is for the symbolic Sturmian beta-shift rather than an interval beta-transformation without further coding work.
title: A two-parameter robust cone of Sturmian-maximizing potentials
